## Use Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono coding font

An accessibility-focused monospace designed to keep similar characters easy to distinguish. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono FAQ

### Is Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono free?

Yes. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono support ligatures?

No. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono?

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
